/* SmsMenuAuthMapper.getSmsMenuList */ SELECT A.RESRCE_CD , A.RESRCE_NM FROM TB_WB_RESRCE_INFO A WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.RESRCE_FG = 'M'
AND A.RESRCE_CD LIKE '%'||#{resrceCd}||'%'
AND A.RESRCE_NM LIKE '%'||#{resrceNm}||'%'
START WITH A.P_RESRCE IN ('000064', '002579', '005259') CONNECT BY PRIOR A.RESRCE_CD = A.P_RESRCE ORDER BY A.RESRCE_CD

/* SmsMenuAuthMapper.getRegUserList */ SELECT A.EMP_NO , A.EMP_NM , A.USER_ID , A.WEB_USE_YN , A.SERVICE_FG , A.USE_YN FROM TB_CM_EMPLOYEE A , TB_WB_AUTHOR_USER_IN_EX B WHERE A.ADMIN_FG = 'A' AND B.USER_ID = A.USER_ID AND B.RESRCE_CD = #{resrceCd} AND B.INCLD_EXCLD_FG = 'I' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY A.EMP_NO

/* SmsMenuAuthMapper.getNoRegUserList */ SELECT A.EMP_NO , A.EMP_NM , A.USER_ID , A.WEB_USE_YN , A.SERVICE_FG , A.USE_YN FROM TB_CM_EMPLOYEE A WHERE A.ADMIN_FG = 'A' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_WB_AUTHOR_USER_IN_EX B WHERE B.USER_ID = A.USER_ID AND B.RESRCE_CD = #{resrceCd} AND B.INCLD_EXCLD_FG = 'I' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' ) ORDER BY A.EMP_NO
